_schema.description: Machine-readable mirror of ADR-INDEX.md. Generated by oya doc adr-index.

decisions.title: Adopt the cohesion thesis — one product across seven axes joined at six shared substrates
Establish the Tenant and Identity kernel as the single substrate every axis consumes
Audit chain and evidence emission as the single tamper-evident record-keeping substrate
Plane separation across control / data / analytics with catalog-declared plane class
Eventing backbone on Apache Kafka with outbox pattern, CloudEvents envelope, and per-tenant per-cell partitioning
Object Graph as the engine-enforced typed-entity layer with per-property tier classification
Cedar policy engine for RBAC/ABAC + persona-tier autonomy ceiling (T1–T4) with per-capability runtime enforcement
Data Use Boundary — twelve data classes with HARD_DENY for PHI/PCI/PIPA-Art23/CHILDREN, orthogonal subject_class, purpose-permission matrix, and four-pillar flow matrix
Cell architecture — per-tenant per-region blast-radius cells with cell-routing primitives at edge / mesh / store / event

Regional pack architecture — canonical seams + per-locale plug-ins for regulatory, compliance, i18n, currency, calendar, tax, identity, payment, address, ecosystem partners, content safety, ad policy, industry data models, and vendor partners

Cross-axis contract registry — `contracts/axis-contracts.yaml` source-of-truth, openapi/proto/asyncapi sub-directories, oya-foundry-fitness-contracts CI lane, cross-axis contract change protocol, auto-generated SDKs
Axis admission protocol — what counts as an axis (vs sub-axis vs vertical vs pack), the current seven, the new-axis admission protocol, and the retire/consolidate protocol

Product license policy — allowed (Apache-2 / MIT / BSD-2/3 / ISC / 0BSD / MPL-2 / Unicode), forbidden in product code (AGPL / GPL), requires-review tier (LGPL / SSPL / BUSL / Elastic / RSAL / TSL / Confluent / AWS-FSL / Commons Clause), dev-only carve-out, oya-foundry-fitness-license CI lane, per-release SBOM

Build-vs-buy policy — per-axis matrix (in-house obligatory / external acceptable / requires-review), decision flow chart, per-dep metadata (license tier + maturity + isolation + replacement plan + owning team), oya-foundry-fitness-build-vs-buy CI lane

Architectural flattening target — flat-crates `crates/oya-<context>-<role>[-<capability>]/`, role taxonomy (kernel / domain / app / api / worker / adapter / runtime), dep-direction kernel←domain←app←api/worker/adapter←runtime, boundary validator, migration path from legacy modules / services / platform tree
Wave and plane integration framework — descriptive wave names (W-Foundation through W-Region-Fan-Out), per-wave gate criteria, status labels (preview / stable / GA), no M0/M1/M2/M3/MVP vocab
decisions.owner: council-architecture + tactical-first-vertical-pilot until first vertical preview ships

decisions.title: Brand naming and repo layout — Oyatie / oYa logo / oyatie.com domain, oya-<context>-<role> Cargo prefix, repo path / GitHub slug oyatie retained, product code uses Oyatie everywhere, dev-side aliases tolerated for ~2 waves then sunset
Glossary and terminology canon — industry-aligned vocabulary, Oyatie-specific terms with industry analog, Korean-English parity table, retired terms appendix, oya-foundry-fitness-glossary CI lane

Doc catalog and update protocol — every consolidated doc has owner / trigger / cadence / dependent-docs / validation; pre-flight + authoring + validation + review + publish stages; agent-authoring policy (agents propose; humans approve except for catalog-validated additions); machine-readable mirror at machine-readable/catalog.json
Foundry multi-provider adapter model — `ProviderAdapter` trait, ProviderAuth, capability-level routing
Foundry capability registry and MCP gateway — `Capability` schema, MCP-compatible discovery, per-tenant endpoint
Autonomy ceiling — runtime enforcement via Cedar policy at every capability invocation
related: ADR-0024 (eval harness; adversarial cases test the ceiling)
ADR-0025 (engineering-platform; same gates apply to agent-authored PRs)

decisions.title: Foundry sandbox — Wasmtime + WASI Preview 2 for short-lived tools, Firecracker microVMs for full-kernel tools
related: ADR-0021 (capability registry — capability declares which sandbox class it needs)
ADR-0022 (autonomy ceiling — sandbox is process-level defense-in-depth)
ADR-0025 (engineering platform — sandbox-spawn metering rolls into scorecards)

decisions.title: Foundry eval harness and replay — per-capability golden sets, A/B routing, adversarial cohorts, regional linguistic eval
related: ADR-0021 (capability registry — eval gate at publish)
ADR-0022 (autonomy ceiling — adversarial cohort tests bypass attempts)
ADR-0023 (sandbox — replay needs deterministic tool execution)
ADR-0026 (in-house substrate — eval is the gate that decides when an in-house variant supplants a provider)

decisions.title: Foundry as the engineering platform — repoctl, catalog, gates, fitness functions, supply chain, customer-facing builder surfaces all under one axis
In-house AI model substrate — long-horizon W-AI-Model-Substrate; consume providers until per-vertical eval suite favors in-house
related: ADR-0020 (provider adapter — the trait extends to in-house IDs)
ADR-0025 (engineering platform — supplies the data and gate substrate)
ADR-0027 (vision/speech/robotics sub-substrates — built on the same kernel)

decisions.title: Robotics, vision, and speech sub-substrates — vision/speech model crates, robotics control plane, deterministic latency, safety-critical anti-scope
related: ADR-0020 (provider adapter — vision/speech models extend the trait)
ADR-0022 (autonomy ceiling — T4 disabled by default for safety-critical actuation)
ADR-0026 (in-house substrate — vision/speech models live on the same kernel)

decisions.title: Cloud provider axis — three-phase compute trajectory with stable product surface
Workspace axis — productivity suite architecture as cohesion-bound replacement for Google Workspace / M365 / Naver Works / Kakao Work
Search axis — crawler / parser / index / ranker / SERP architecture with KR-first morphology and Data-Use-Boundary segregation
Ads + Analytics axis — singleton tenant-ads-gate sourcing, sub-100ms auction, privacy-preserving attribution, Data-Use-Boundary at runtime
DCIM software for Oyatie-owned DC operations — `crates/oya-cloud-dcops-*` with anti-scope on custom silicon
Vertical industry cloud pack architecture — per-vertical bounded contexts with kernel/domain/app/adapter/api/worker/runtime layers
Per-vertical data class overrides — vertical-side hard-deny pack that tenant admin cannot raise
Workflow engine — hybrid state-machine + DAG (not pure BPMN), per-tenant versioning, jurisdiction overlay, agent-authored steps
Plugin substrate — Wasmtime + WASI Preview 2 with capability-gated context, Cosign signing, trust tiers, marketplace economics
Public API stability tiers — preview / stable / GA with semver-diff PR gate, contract-first SDK generation, per-deprecation telemetry
Trust framework — cross-axis lineage, DSR cascade across all seven axes, Cosign-signed proof-of-erasure, tenant trust portal
Supply chain security — Trivy 4-layer scan, Cosign keyless signing, SBOM dual-format, signed commits and tags, Kyverno admission
Progressive delivery — Argo Rollouts canary, blue-green for stateful surfaces, metric-gated rollback at SLO burn-rate ≥ 14.4×
GitOps — trunk-based development with release branch cut at tag, merge queue with one-PR-at-a-time root-Cargo-touch
Observability stack — OpenTelemetry SDK + VictoriaMetrics, in-house Leptos portal long-horizon, gen_ai semconv per capability
Secrets management — OpenBao (MPL-2; supersedes Vault BUSL), per-tenant per-cell HSM partition (KCMVP + FIPS 140-3), per-capability SecretProvider
Service mesh — Istio Ambient mode for east-west, Envoy as edge gateway, mTLS everywhere, per-cell namespace, audited cross-cell traffic
Database tier strategy — PostgreSQL + Citus for OLTP, ClickHouse-fork for OLAP, Iceberg + DataFusion for lakehouse
Vector store strategy — pgvector day-1, in-house Rust HNSW/IVF at billion-scale long-horizon, FAISS only as adapter
Search backend strategy — pgroonga day-1 (LGPL legal isolation), Tantivy in-Rust at scale, OpenSearch as Apache-2 adapter, in-house long-horizon
Korean morphology + multilingual tokenization — `Tokenizer` trait per language family, mecab-ko + khaiii FFI day-1, in-house Rust port long-horizon
Cross-region replication + residency — per-pack default residency class, opt-in cross-region per consent, immutable post-create
Automation-first pipeline — Google + Amazon doctrine, sccache + remote execution, affected-graph testing, Foundry-driven PR triage
Mobile and Native Client Strategy
